protocol.title: Single-asset options implied-vol term ratio (near/far near-ATM IV) -> forward expected shortfall / CVaR of the signed return predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (identical term_ratio signal via _term_bars) + EVAL-102 (single-asset term_ratio signal path verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed / zwindow); distinct cell: single-asset term_ratio -> forward CVaR (expected shortfall) of signed return
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-102 (term_ratio -> signed return mean) with a tail-risk target (CVaR); no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term structure from the real Deribit option trade tape: term_ratio = IV(near expiry)/IV(far expiry) - 1, forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward CVaR (expected shortfall) of signed log-returns = mean of the worst CVAR_ALPHA-tail of the next H perp log returns, strictly after the decision at bar k
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(term_ratio_z_k, cvar_forward_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher near/far IV ratio -> higher forward expected shortfall)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
